name: MIP (Mexico Infrastructure Partners)
verdict: MIP (Mexico Infrastructure Partners) is an independent, partner-owned Mexican energy and infrastructure investment manager. Nothing found.
note: Fireballs GC partner; its logo on livgolf.com/fireballs-gc links to mexicoinfra.com (verified in the page HTML, 2026-10-03). The firm's May 4, 2026 release describes it as an independent, partner-owned manager founded in 2012 and headquartered in Mexico City (mip-partner-owned); its current release URL was opened and quote-checked on 2026-10-13. Mexico News Daily independently reports its energy and infrastructure investment-manager description. Individual partners' stakes remain unknown. No state or state-fund owner found, no human-rights finding found.
